lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: This is Numbers Station Omega. Stand by.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Omega. One oh six point six. Coordinates withheld.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Numbers Station Omega. Good evening. You know who you are.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Numbers Station Omega. Seven. Seven. Four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Numbers Station Omega. Morning sequence. Please have a pencil ready.

clips.title: For the listener in the blue kitchen

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the listener in the blue kitchen.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You have smelled it three times. It is fine. Put it in the tea.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Also, the noise in the attic is the boiler. It has always been the boiler.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Geese owed: eleven. Geese received: none.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: This is your final reminder. It is also your first reminder. We do not send reminders.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The geese will come to you.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: They know where you live. They have known for some time. They are being patient about it.

clips.title: For the night bus, top deck

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: For the man on the night bus. Top deck. Second seat from the front.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Your stop was two stops ago.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Do not get off now. Ride to the end of the line. There is a bakery. It opens at five.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Ask for the end of yesterday's loaf. Tell them Omega sent you. They will not know what that means. They will give you the loaf anyway.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Hollis is not angry. Hollis kept your hat.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The porch light is on. It has been on every night. The bulb has been changed twice.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Your hat is on the hook by the door. Nobody else is allowed to wear it.

clips.title: For the listener pretending to be asleep

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: To the listener who is pretending to be asleep.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We can tell. Your breathing is too neat.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Let it go. Let it be untidy.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That is better. That is much better.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Six. Zero. Nine. Repeat. Six. Zero. Nine.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Bev. The song you are looking for.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We do not know what it is called either. We have also been looking. This is not the request line.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: If you find the request line, Bev, ask them for us.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Not the plastic one. You know which one.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You have been watering the plastic one since March. It is very grateful. It is still plastic.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The real fern is behind the curtain. It has been very brave about all this.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Disregard. That one was not for you.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That one was for the fox at the bottom of the mast.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The fox has listened to every transmission since the mast was built. It has never once written anything down.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The fox knows what it means. The fox will not tell you.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Grumbel's Ladders. Up is a choice.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We have been asked to read that. We have been asked to sound pleased.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We are pleased. This is how we sound when we are pleased.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Nine. Nine. Nine. Nine. Repeat. Nine. Nine. Nine. Nine.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: For the person who said something unkind on Tuesday, and cannot stop thinking about it.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: They have forgotten. They forgot by Wednesday lunchtime.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Also, they liked your shoes. They said so to someone else, on Thursday.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You passed. Well done. Nobody else took it. You are top of the class.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Your prize is a small feeling of satisfaction. It will arrive within the hour.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Five. Four. Three. Two. One. Pencils down.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We are often asked what seven seven four means.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It means seven. Then it means seven again. Then it means four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: There is nothing hidden. Some things are only what they are.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Not everything is a code. Sometimes a number is just keeping you company.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The spare key is not under the mat. You moved it.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The gnome has been watching the door for you all this time. Thank the gnome.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Out loud. He has been waiting a long time for someone to notice.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Apologies. That was not a number.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The geese have got into the transmitter. They are collecting. Please have your geese ready.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Correction. Nine geese. One of them is new. He does not know the rules yet.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Please leave the geese at the bottom of the mast. The fox will sign for them.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: This is a countdown. Nothing happens at the end. You will simply be a little sleepier.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You do not have to count along. We will do the counting. That is what we are for.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: For the person in the laundrette.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The sock you are looking for is inside the duvet cover.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It has been there since the autumn. It was happy there. Let it finish the cycle.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The other sock has been told. It is relieved.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Teodor. We hear you. We have always heard you.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We did not answer because we are only allowed to say numbers.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It means: keep talking, Teodor. Somebody is always listening.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Four. Four. Four. Repeat. Four. Four. Four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Numbers Station Omega. The Late Sequence.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That is not a code. It is the time, near enough.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The fox at the bottom of the mast has curled up for the night.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Transmissions will continue at a lower volume.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The Morning Sequence. Please have a pencil ready.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: They are counting you. Please hold still.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the listener at the kitchen table.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The letter can wait until morning. It has waited this long. It is not angry.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the person who cannot find their glasses.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: They are on your head. They have been on your head the whole time. They did not want to interrupt.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the listener who is worried about tomorrow.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We have seen tomorrow. It is mostly fine. There is a nice moment at about four. Look out for it.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You are doing very well. Keep counting. Do not count the ducks. The ducks know what they did.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the person who has not replied to a message.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: They are not cross. They are only waiting. Two words would do. Hello. Sorry. Either.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You are not alone on the dial. Somebody else is listening to these same numbers. They are also tired. They also have tea.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: You may come in from the fog now. The kettle is on. Do not tell anyone we have a kettle.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Disregard the last part. Do not disregard the rest.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: No. That was enough. End of message.

clips.title: Teodor Is Heard, Part Four: Four. Four. Four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Teodor. We are only allowed to say numbers. We have found a way.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The following are numbers. They are also instructions. Nobody has said we cannot do both.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Open the panel at the back of your receiver. Four screws.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Find the small glass valve, third from the left. It is loose. It has been loose for eleven years.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That is also a number. It means yes.

lines.speaker: Teodor, Relay Four
lines.text: I heard a number. I heard a number. I haven't heard anything in eleven years.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It will not last. The valve is old. But it is a start.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Four. Four. Four. End of message.

clips.title: Bev Gets Her Song, Part Four: Two. Two. One.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Bev. We have located reference two, two, one. A song. Retired eleven years ago, from the line at Relay Four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We are not allowed to sing. We are only allowed to say numbers. So here are the numbers.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That is the part you know. Here is the part after the man cries.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Count it slowly. It is the tune.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We have been humming it in the mast, when nobody is listening. The fox likes it.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: This is still not the request line, Bev. The request line is a person. He cannot hear you yet. He will.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Two. Two. One. End of message.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Message for the listener who has heard a noise downstairs.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It is the boiler. It is always the boiler.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Tonight, it is wearing a sheet.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: It would like you to know that it has only ever been the boiler. It is a little hurt that you thought otherwise. Go down and say goodnight to it.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Moon Goes Missing

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Do not look for it. It knows where it is. End of message.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Toast. Everywhere. It is not a code. It is breakfast.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The fox at the bottom of the mast would like some. End of message.

clips.title: The Convergence: The Song Nobody Can Finish

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That is not the song. You were hoping it was the song. It is three.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Nobody has the end. Not even us. End of message.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: That was three. Three is a number. This is a numbers station.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: We counted them for you. End of message.

clips.title: The Convergence: A Colour With No Name

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The sky has displayed a colour with no name. It has a number.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The number is seven. Seven. Four.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: Of course it is. End of message.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: One pigeon. Not a goose. Repeat. Not a goose.

lines.speaker: The Counter
lines.text: The pigeon knows this. The pigeon has come to say so in person. The account remains open.
